text:
Lina: noticed a handful of interviewers are still using the legacy scorecard link in event descriptions. A candidate called to ask why their interviewer couldn't submit.

Ravi: which link is that? the old /form/v1 vs /forms/v2?

Lina: old: https://ats.redwood.com/forms/v1/interviewer. New is /forms/v2/interviewer-scorecard. We swapped defaults last week but calendar templates might not have updated for recurring events.

Jo: this is timing with the webhook retries we turned on Friday. Could be duplicate attempts + CVs hitting deprecated endpoints. Any 4xxs in the webhook logs?

Emily: pulled logs: 410 Gone for submissions originating from v1. Also a handful of 429s from bursty submit traffic when interviews ended. Link: https://logs.redwood.com/recruiting?query=forms%2Fv1+410

lina: oh no. Does the ATS still accept v1 and map it? We intentionally deprecated it.

ats-infra: System: v1 endpoint removed at 2026-03-20T05:00Z as scheduled. We retained a 30d redirect window but form payloads with field names old_scorecard_* will 410.

Ravi: ok, action items: 1) quick manual import for any v1 submissions we still have stored, 2) patch calendar invites for recurring interviews, 3) ping hiring managers + interviewers about the new link and a 10-min refresher.

Jo: I can write a small script to normalize v1 -> v2 payloads and POST to /candidates/:id/feedback. Will need a CSV of failed events. @lina can you export?

Lina: exporting now. dropping to /shared/recruiting/failed_forms_v1_20260320.csv. Columns: event_id, candidate_id, raw_payload_snippet, submit_ts.

Emily: note: some v1 payloads have the old_scorecard_scale (1-4) while v2 expects 1-5 and text fields moved. I'll include a mapping table in the export README.

Ravi: thanks. Also, calendar template fix: @emily can you coordinate with IT to update the default interview template and push a calendar patch for events owned by the recruiting mailbox? Need a safe window so we don't edit ownerless events.

Emily: will do. Plan: update template by 11:00, then run a dry-run script to list affected events, then patch events created after 2025-01-01 and owned by recruiter@redwood.com.

hr-bot: Reminder: Interviewer refresher drop-in scheduled Thu 15:00 PT. Slides published: https://docs.redwood.com/hiring/interviewer-refresh. :bell:

Jo: I'll start the backfill script now. Will post progress here (batch size 50). If we hit validation errors I'll write them to backfill_errors.json and hand to product for schema guidance.

Lina: please tag me on errors. Also, can we surface a little banner in the recruiting dashboard warning about deprecated forms so recruiters don't create invites with the old link?

ravi: good idea. @eng-prod can we add a temporary banner? (cc @lina)

ats-infra: System: created a feature request ticket INF-478 for deprecation banner and re-run safe-patch job. ETA 2 business days.

Lina: thanks everyone. Priority order: backfill stored v1 submissions, push calendar template update, send short comms + nudge to interviewers. Will confirm when CSV placed and when backfill completes.
